ينفرد (form VII)
# يَنْفَرِدُ (yanfaridu) /jan.fa.ri.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَرَدَ (infarada)
# يَنْفَرِدَ (yanfarida) /jan.fa.ri.da/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَرَدَ (infarada)
# يَنْفَرِدْ (yanfarid) /jan.fa.rid/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَرَدَ (infarada)
